system.description:
Prerequisites: Basic Chimerstry, Intermediate Fortitude. Developed by the Kshatriyas caste, this combination Discipline transfers a wound's pain — and effectively the wound itself, for a time — onto an attacker.

System: The Ravnos spends one Blood Point and rolls Manipulation + Intimidation (difficulty equal to the victim's Perception + Self-Control); each success lets her ignore one health level of damage and inflict that level's pain on the attacker instead for the remainder of the scene. She still carries the wound itself — she simply doesn't feel it.

Costs 10 Experience Traits to learn.

MET: The Ravnos spends one Blood Trait and wins a Social Challenge (Intimidation retest) against the target, then spends one Social Trait per level of damage transferred. Endurance does not block this transferred pain.
